name: Camp Eastwood
description_short: Short session overnight camp for boys and girls ages 6 to 10 (finishing kindergarten to 4th grade) in the Belgrade Lakes region, with an address in Oakland. Mini Camp and one and two week sessions offer swimming, hiking, crafts and games as a first step toward longer overnight camp.

Camp Eastwood is run by the Camp Somerset and Camp Manitou team (Manitou is published in Oakland). The site does not say whether it shares Manitou's or Somerset's grounds; it has its own address, so it is drafted as its own camp.
